size_pct_nav: Over $3.5 billion including options, funds and dedicated SPV; roughly 40 million shares. Not a verified single-fund NAV weight.
first_action_window: Purchase/position change predates or coincides with disclosure; exact first transaction date not recovered.

plan.governance_route: P1→P2; see dated drivers; implementation is not assumed in desk evidence.

drivers.driver: The best-positioned consumer portfolio was under-earning after years of stalled EPS and peer underperformance.
drivers.quote: It is rare to find a business of Nestlé's quality with so many avenues for improvement.

drivers.driver: An explicit 18–20% margin objective by 2020 could impose accountability and close the operating gap.
An underlevered balance sheet could support repurchases and more efficient capital allocation.
Monetizing the non-core L'Oréal stake and pruning the portfolio could unlock hidden value.
Outside CEO Mark Schneider and operating adviser Jan Bennink created a credible change window.

entry_valuation_stated: 2016 underlying EPS CHF3.40; activist forecast CHF5–6 by 2020; entry cost not recovered.
outcome_note: Company announced a 17.5–18.5% margin target and CHF20bn buyback, not the activist's exact 18–20% request. Final realized return and exit unresolved.
